capabilities: Apply one of four color theme presets (Lavender, Warm, Ocean, Forest)
Style chat bubble callouts with chat-r and chat-l callouts and emoji indicators
Inject chat callouts into the Outline pane as virtual headings
Keep the Outline pane pinned to the last active markdown file
Tune colors, table radius, and code block styling from settings without editing CSS
disambiguation: Not a pure CSS theme; it bundles theme styling with JavaScript features like outline injection and a sticky outline.
extras: Users must set Settings > Appearance > CSS Theme to none so the plugin supplies all styling. Installation is manual (copying the folder into .obsidian/plugins/).
motivation: The author explains that a pure theme cannot execute JavaScript, so the plugin bundles styling with one JS-requiring feature (outline injection).
problem: Obsidian themes are CSS-only and cannot run JavaScript, so chat callouts cannot be made to appear in the Outline pane or receive other behavior that requires code.

relations.evidence: they appear in the Outline pane (including Quiet Outline)

summary: Theme plugin offering 4 color presets, chat-bubble callouts, rounded tables, and JavaScript-powered outline injection for chat callouts.
